name: Akari Kutsuki
source:
Emblematic of everything we need to fight for.

A case study in why this isn't okay anymore.

The reason we must no longer be silent.

The most effected by his horrible actions, the same actions that have done irreversible damage to the cause.

Do not forget her.

She won't forget.

[From the [url=https://danganronpa-fanganprojects.fandom.com/wiki/Akari_Kutsuki_(Danganronpa_Antebellum:_LOCKDOWN)]Wiki[/url]]
